<div class="doxyMemberItem">

<span class="doxyMemberLabel static">static</span>
</span>
</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Returns optimised value on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">IsTrue</span> branch.</p>


<p>For <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/selectinst">SelectInst</a> that would be either True or False value. For (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/binaryoperator">BinaryOperator</a>) instructions, where the condition may be skipped, the operation will use a non-conditional operand. For example, for <span class="doxyComputerOutput">or(V,zext(cond))</span> this function would return V. However, if the conditional operand on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">IsTrue</span> branch matters, we create a clone of instruction at the end of that branch <span class="doxyComputerOutput">B</span> and replace the condition operand with a constant.</p>


<p>Also /p OptSelects contains previously optimised select-like instructions. If the current value uses one of the optimised values, we can optimise it further by replacing it with the corresponding value on the given branch</p>
